settings.meaning: Each key is the vector index setting of the same name in YQL's WITH (...) clause. distance or similarity names the metric, vector_type the element type, vector_dimension the number of elements in a vector, levels the depth of the k-means tree and clusters the clusters each level splits into. A setting left out is not stated.

ptah.run/ydb/vector-index.constraint: The settings the declaration states. Any of them may be missing, and the stage that builds the index refuses a declaration YDB would refuse. The value is present on every index the declaration makes a vector index.
Exactly one of distance and similarity, a vector_type and a vector_dimension are present. levels and clusters are what the server reported, left out where it reported none.

canonicalization: Keys are written in the order above. Names are in lower case.
